summary: RTB Digital filed an 8-K confirming share issuance after a business combination closed on May 12, 2026, resulting in 13,619,997 shares outstanding as of June 18, 2026. No terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is a routine administrative update. There is no special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The filing simply updates outstanding share count and does not initiate or announce a strategic transaction or corporate action.
